name: Tsuyuguchi Keiji
source:
The father of Manami. Looks like a good man, at least from the outside. 

Holds quite a high position at a major bank, and is the founder of Ubai organization. 

[spoiler]After discovering that Gen had carnal relations with the wife he just married, Keiji realized that he has an NTR fetish.[/spoiler]

[Translated from [url=http://www.ubai.org/ubai_ending/ubai_chara.html]Official Site[/url]]
